name: @playform/lib-dsh-style
description: The STYLE: the one runtime stylesheet injector of the UI family (@playform/lib-dsh-style) - the single <style> mount every client plugin calls, keyed by the data-plugin-css attribute, appended to the document head once per plugin file, with no removal path. A plugin binds its identifier to its compiled sheet and calls Inject; the mount dedupes by key and guards SSR, and it owns no ledger string, no loader contract and no dependency on any family package - the CLASSIC, dependency-free build of the classical group. Usable outside the harness entirely (the PlayForm ecosystem).
